description: Client construction. `config` is applied over `baseConfig`; a case either resolves (`resolved`) or fails at construction with exactly `error`. Option names are camelCase here; each SDK maps them to its own spelling (spec.json configFields), in messages too.

cases.name: a secret with dots is fine; only the client ID may not have one
an empty query or fragment is no query
no gateway ignores the other options
half a config
cases.error: Payment gateway config is incomplete: missing secret. Set all three or none.

cases.name: half a config, two missing
cases.error: Payment gateway config is incomplete: missing baseUrl, clientId. Set all three or none.

cases.name: plain http elsewhere
cases.error: Payment gateway baseUrl must use https (plain http is allowed only for localhost).

cases.name: another scheme
cases.error: Payment gateway baseUrl must use https (plain http is allowed only for localhost).

cases.name: no scheme
cases.error: Payment gateway baseUrl is not a URL: gateway.example

cases.name: no host
cases.error: Payment gateway baseUrl is not a URL: https://

cases.name: a bad port
cases.error: Payment gateway baseUrl is not a URL: https://gateway.example:99999

cases.name: credentials in the URL
cases.error: Payment gateway baseUrl must be a plain origin/path, without credentials, query or fragment.

cases.name: a query
cases.error: Payment gateway baseUrl must be a plain origin/path, without credentials, query or fragment.

cases.name: a fragment
cases.error: Payment gateway baseUrl must be a plain origin/path, without credentials, query or fragment.

cases.name: a client ID with a dot
cases.error: Payment gateway clientId must not contain a dot.

cases.name: the URL is checked before the client ID
cases.error: Payment gateway baseUrl must use https (plain http is allowed only for localhost).

cases.name: zero timeout
cases.error: Payment gateway timeoutMs must be a positive number.

cases.name: negative budget
cases.error: Payment gateway totalBudgetMs must be a positive number.

cases.name: timeout as a string
cases.error: Payment gateway timeoutMs must be a positive number.

cases.name: timeout as a boolean
cases.error: Payment gateway timeoutMs must be a positive number.

cases.name: fractional retries
cases.error: Payment gateway maxRetries must be a whole number ≥ 0.

cases.name: negative retries
cases.error: Payment gateway maxRetries must be a whole number ≥ 0.

cases.name: timeouts are checked in order
